t: Modular Storage is a searchable storage block. Insert a $(l:rftoolsbase:modularstorage/storagemodules)Storage Module$(/l) to define how many stacks it can hold.
模块化存储器是一种支持搜索的存储方块。插入$(l:rftoolsbase:modularstorage/storagemodules)存储模块$(/l)以定义其可容纳的物品堆叠数量。
The block stores items in the module, so the module can keep its contents when moved. Higher tier modules unlock larger inventories.
该方块将物品存于模块内，因此模块在移动时可保留其内容。更高阶模块可解锁更大的物品栏容量。
Use the GUI to search, sort, compact, and cycle through visible inventory sizes. The module slot controls the actual storage capacity.
通过GUI可执行搜索、排序、压缩及循环切换可见物品栏尺寸等操作。模块插槽则控制实际存储容量。
